issues.label: Agent-native semantic GPU debugger and profiler
Deterministic CPU semantic simulator and virtual GPU runtime

capabilities.label: Rust ownership and result flow
capabilities.detail: rustc remains the only Rust borrow checker: it enforces moves, borrows, lifetimes, visibility, and local typestate. Fe2O3 extends those rules with sealed non-Clone GPU capabilities and workload-neutral cross-invocation verification. Typed kernels may return KernelResult and use ?, while the macro emits a private unit-ABI entry wrapper and the compiler retains the helper's real MIR. Err ends only the current invocation and is not a host-visible error channel.

capabilities.label: Pliron context ownership
capabilities.detail: Process-local context identities, registered dialects, and context-bound handles are checked before operations are inspected. Generic safety passes execute today; issue #140 tracks stronger owner-aware upstream arena handles rather than blocking the production verifier sequence.

capabilities.label: Generic pre-lowering safety
capabilities.detail: The fixed nine-pass workload-neutral pre-lowering sequence verifies rooted tensor-layout composition, ranked bounds and checked machine-index arithmetic, atomic legality, cross-invocation race freedom, complete hierarchy ownership, barrier and SIMT collective protocol convergence, staged pipeline lifecycles and epoch-slot relations, workgroup-memory initialization/publication, and semantic refinement. The semantic stage now fails closed on unproved loop progress and on changed numerical operator trees without an error theorem. A separate compiler-supplied target precondition checks launch geometry, static LDS use, and origin-bound host allocation size and alignment before the same nine passes; it grants no launch authority. Compiler-derived tensor roots connect producers to operand and accumulator consumers; incompatible ABI flow and producer joins are compile-time errors. Every diagnostic includes a concrete repair or states the missing proof obligation. Rejected and Incomplete findings both stop production compilation before lowering.

capabilities.label: Middle-end evidence custody
capabilities.detail: The production middle end has one fixed nine-pass sequence and one live evidence producer: ProductionMiddleEndEvidenceV5. The pipeline-protocol pass runs after barrier convergence and before workgroup-memory verification, so its epoch certificate becomes an input to must-initialization/publication checking. The V4 decoder is strict and archival-only; it cannot produce live evidence or grant refinement, lowering, artifact, or launch authority. The caller-declared ProductionReferenceProofV1 and RequireReferenceEquivalent API is removed. Target-aware entry points perform bounded structural inventory before recursive PLIRON verification and launch-contract scanning, with malformed, nested, unsupported, or over-limit input failing as FE2O3-TARGET-000. The rejected source/ranked diagnostic sidecar is not present; same-TyCtxt descriptor identity hardens substitution without closing FE2O3-RACE-002.

capabilities.label: Unified production route
capabilities.detail: Ordinary safe Rust enters one production architecture: semantic MIR is projected into ranked PLIRON, checked normalization and the fixed verification sequence run there, and the admitted result is carried into target-selected canonical Kernel IR and formal-memory admission. The retired standalone AMDGCN/PLIRON-to-LLVM and KIR/PLIRON bridge packages have been deleted; no alternate host, lowering, or source-first simulator route can bypass the ranked transaction. GFX950 Semantic MIR V6 and Kernel IR V9 selection is derived from live collective and LDS-transpose operations rather than a workload or function name. Under the exact gfx950:xnack- full-active Wave64 profile, f32 subgroup reductions accept every nonzero power-of-two tile width through 64; unsupported widths, targets, profiles, and dynamic source lanes fail closed. Earlier MI300X and MI350X measurements remain historical observations at their original commits, not current launch commands or authority for this unpinned compiler state. Unsupported effects, witnesses, and ownership forms remain deliberately fail-closed.

capabilities.label: Bounded compiler analysis
capabilities.detail: The sole fixed nine-stage analysis route shares closed CFG, SSA, uniformity, sparse index, Presburger, provenance, memory-order, SIMT, pipeline-epoch, and bounded invocation facts without recognizing a workload. The pipeline stage proves stage, commit, wait, consume-or-discard, and release order; release-before-reuse; epoch modulo buffer count; disjoint storage; uniform dynamic bounds; and summarized prologue, steady-state, and drain regions without unrolling runtime loops. Analysis-only stages are protected by a context-wide monotonic PLIRON mutation-attempt epoch, exact structural checkpoints, and sealed report custody. Independent raw replay is Complete only for the admitted single-block static bounded-access fragment: invocation dimensions must be finite and unique; at most one execution layout is allowed, and any retained layout must exactly match the active dimension inventory. All extents and index operations must be supported, and checked u64 replay must stay within its resource cap. Nonempty tensor-layout replay remains Incomplete until external roots have explicit operational-SSA provenance. Checked tiled and row-striped recipes now carry a structural index, checked-success capability, and destination physical extent. Deterministic typed live verification checks pairing, shape, substitution resistance, exactly one predicated use, and no unpaired index use. The carrier grants no source-semantic authority: raw, textual, and current public recipes still fail closed with FE2O3-RACE-002 until owner-custodied semantic MIR correspondence, the exact receiver/fat-pointer extent, the two relevant Option::Some paths, allowed-use and CFG-dominance proof, source provenance/noalias, and retained KIR replay exist. Generic explicit affine and bounded Presburger maps remain supported. Canonical single-entry multi-block forwarding loops require a positive constant step plus source-width and u64 no-wrap proofs. Authenticated MIR projection may emit the value-producing kernel.index_unsigned_cast only when the exact source range makes its unsigned-width conversion value-preserving and the exact source recurrence has been replayed. One production transformation folds exact preceding index constants after independent exact typed replay, retaining one input clone and moving the validated output through private receipt custody. The current production matrix reaches FE2O3-RACE-002 before KIR, so it carries no Clean race, KIR, functional-domain, lowering, launch, or hardware claim.

capabilities.label: Safe Rust functional references
capabilities.detail: The published compiler baseline runs one generated Verus checker that replays supported exact pointwise integer and compiler-side IEEE operator-DAG formulas from compiler-derived coordinates, domains, preconditions, and values; no generic relation premise supplies equality. PLIRON separately proves and reconciles total coverage, allocation separation, frames, schedules, and ordered-product identity, while a private move-only join requires both structural and formula reports. Status-Checked policy staging grants no authority. Canonical positive-step loops carry termination evidence only when the backedge update is statically nonwrapping; concrete nontermination is Rejected and an unsupported ranking proof is Incomplete. Dynamic slice reads are complete only for exact identical symbolic ranked extents or overflow-checked bounded static affine intervals; unrelated independent lengths, missing assertions, unsafe intervals, and overflow fail closed. Identical live typed floating-point trees receive an exact-zero error certificate; reassociation, changed operation order, and nonzero ErrorBounded replay remain unsupported. A tensor reference must name the exact propagated accumulator result root and match its component count and semantic scalar before value/store refinement can pass. This composes the target-owned physical layout proof with the safe Rust/Verus semantic obligation; the reference is not treated as a hardware-layout oracle. mi300x lacks the fixed retained /opt runtime, so no referenced production compile has completed this gate and there is no fallback. Compiler extraction/projection and analysis-result or transformation soundness, target IEEE values, LLVM-or-later lowering, target instruction arithmetic, artifacts, launch, hardware, and performance remain outside the claim.

capabilities.label: Target finalization
capabilities.detail: Archived pinned runs emitted gfx942 LLVM, linked HSACO, and compared selected kernel outputs with independent CPU references; those records remain historical evidence only. The current production architecture retains target-finalization components behind the sole Worker V3 application path, but this unpinned compiler state has no completed source-to-machine authority or current tutorial launch command. Protected publication, load, dispatch, numerical refinement, and complete compiler refinement remain separate.

capabilities.label: Runtime and persistent execution
capabilities.detail: At the published baseline, pure-Rust KFD topology, memory, queue, packet, typed lifecycle, and debug-trap foundations are present. KfdTargetRuntimeDebugTokenV1 transfers linearly into the generic compute-AQL queue lifecycle. The thread-bound debugger validates ptrace ownership and pidfd identity, owns an admitted /dev/kfd descriptor and notifier, acknowledges runtime transitions, and exposes the strict hardware V2 protocol with redacted generation-aware device/queue snapshots, bounded runtime and exception events, suspend/resume, terminate, launch control, and an owned address-watch lifecycle. Live MI300X validation observes the real queue and suspend/resume controls without a HIP or HSA runtime. The direct-KFD semantic observation boundary still does not dispatch work, and the debugger does not authenticate watch addresses against allocations, decode CWSR wave/register state, read target memory, or correlate machine state to source or KIR. Production publication and load custody use the sole Worker V3 application path; Worker V2 application routing is retired and cannot provide an alternate route. These records grant no completed production load, launch, persistent execution, source-level hardware debugging, or profiling authority; issues #135, #137, and #215 retain those obligations.

capabilities.label: Compiler execution attestation
capabilities.detail: The protected authority service admits a hardened static issuer and immutable Ed25519 key, then maintains one signed, singleton, crash-safe compiler-execution journal with exact recovery and mutation checks. No public API can construct the supervised compiler-occurrence token. Supervised occurrence production, the bounded service loop, Worker V3 receipt carriage, and its independent protected rollback ledger remain open, so this mechanism grants no compiler, publication, load, or launch authority.

capabilities.label: Semantic debugging and profiling
capabilities.detail: The semantic debugger records bounded execution-derived checkpoints and exposes a strict versioned JSONL session. CPU sessions support thread, logical Wave32/Wave64, workgroup, and dispatch views; persistent barrier residency; KIR and compiler-bundle-bound source resolution, breakpoints, and stepping; allocation-relative watchpoints and memory; SSA snapshots; paged captured call stacks; faults; exact schedule replay; deterministic transcript reverse navigation; and typed unavailable values. Source-variable inspection remains typed unavailable because V1 maps source sites rather than variable-to-SSA identity. The tutorial retains an exact raw-KIR workbench and adds an exact ordinary-Rust bundle transcript for agents. Compiler-bundle binding authenticates exact local map/KIR content, not protected compiler execution. Pure-KFD hardware V2 separately exposes redacted device/queue snapshots, runtime and exception events, suspend/resume, terminate, launch control, and address-watch lifecycle. CPU logical waves are not hardware waves, and native registers, CWSR decoding, target-memory reads, hardware wave/lane/source/KIR control, counters, PC samples, ATT decoding, capture comparison, automated diagnosis, and the profiler UI remain open in issue #215.

capabilities.label: Source-to-bundle CPU semantic simulation
capabilities.detail: The Linux-only fe2o3-kir-sim CLI securely admits either exact verified canonical KIR V7 or an authority-free .fe2sim plus a strict typed request. fe2o3-export-sim supplies the bundle from ordinary attributed Rust through the sole production source/MIR/PLIRON/KIR transaction, with an embedded compiler-bundle-bound map; it is not a resurrected source-first simulator route. The simulator executes the supported reachable subset with bounded deterministic CPU semantics, formal memory, checked resident accounting, copied results, conflict observations, and an opt-in debugger sink. Canonical and seeded schedules persist exact artifact, request, target, limits, context, transcript, coverage, seed, and runnable decisions for strict replay, including debugger capture. Admitted integer atomic kinds and legal scopes/orderings, explicit fences, and exact software F16/BF16/F32/F64 scalar bits are implemented; unsupported math, float atomics, wave/matrix operations, and other absent semantics fail closed. The bundle authenticates local content, not compiler execution, and grants no source refinement, proof, race-freedom theorem, GPU equivalence, artifact/load/launch authority, timing, profiling, performance, or performance prediction. Issue #216 tracks remaining semantic and virtual-runtime breadth.
